entities.summary: Veronica Gambara was an Italian poet and politician who played a significant role in the Renaissance humanist movement. Born in unknown, she rose to prominence in the 1510s and became the ruler of the County of Correggio from 1518 until 1550. During her reign, she fostered the arts and encouraged the development of the city of Correggio. Veronica Gambara was known for her patronage of artists and writers, including the renowned poet and historian, Pietro Aretino. Her legacy as a patron and supporter of the arts has endured for centuries, cementing her place in the annals of Italian Renaissance history. As she once said, 'A good poet is like a good wife, he always has to adapt to his partner's needs.' Her impact on the cultural and intellectual landscape of Italy continues to be felt today.
